title: Sr. Software Engineer B2
description:
Job Summary
  
This hybrid role for a senior software engineer demands strong experience in Kubernetes Python and SQL to design develop and optimize scalable enterprise applications that support critical merchandising workflows. The candidate will collaborate across functional teams during day shifts to deliver secure reliable systems that enhance operational efficiency and generate measurable business value for a global organization.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Design and implement robust backend services and data workflows using Python and SQL that enable scalable and maintainable enterprise applications supporting core business operations and decision making
  
Develop containerized applications and microservices with Kubernetes to ensure high availability automated scaling and resilient deployment of production workloads across hybrid environments
  
Optimize application performance and database queries by analyzing metrics profiling code and applying tuning techniques that improve response times and resource utilization for complex transactional systems
  
Create and maintain secure APIs and integration layers that connect internal platforms and third party systems to streamline data exchange and reduce manual operational overhead
  
Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs that align with strategic objectives and deliver measurable outcomes for the organization
  
Review and refine existing system architectures to identify enhancements in reliability observability and maintainability while reducing technical debt and operational risk
  
Implement automated testing and continuous integration practices that increase release quality and reduce regression issues across services built with Python and data layers powered by SQL
  
Monitor production systems and Kubernetes clusters using standardized tooling to proactively detect issues drive root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective measures
  
Document system designs data models and deployment procedures in clear and accessible formats that support cross team collaboration and smooth onboarding for new engineering colleagues
  
Collaborate with data and analytics teams to ensure SQL data structures and pipelines are optimized for reporting forecasting and insights that support informed merchandising decisions when applicable
  
Drive adoption of secure coding practices and data protection standards within Python services and SQL data stores to safeguard sensitive information and comply with organizational policies
  
Coordinate work in a hybrid model and day shift schedule to support timely communication with distributed teams and maintain consistent progress against delivery milestones
  
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating new tools and practices in Kubernetes and Python ecosystems that increase engineering productivity and system reliability
  
  

Qualifications
  
Possess strong hands on experience designing and building production grade services using Python with a focus on clean code structure and reusable components for enterprise applications
  
Demonstrate advanced proficiency in SQL for modeling data structures writing complex queries and optimizing execution plans to support transactional and analytical workloads
  
Bring practical experience managing Kubernetes based deployments including configuration scaling and troubleshooting to ensure resilient and efficient application delivery
  
Show familiarity with hybrid work models and collaborative tools that enable effective coordination across onsite and remote team members during standard day shift schedules
  
Apply sound knowledge of software engineering principles including version control code review practices and automated testing to maintain high quality deliverables
  
Exhibit awareness of security best practices in application and data design to reduce vulnerabilities and protect organizational assets across services and databases
  
Preferably have exposure to merchandising domain processes such as assortment planning pricing or inventory optimization to better align technical solutions with business value
  
Display strong communication and problem solving abilities to analyze complex requirements propose pragmatic solutions and articulate technical decisions to diverse stakeholders

title: Software Engineer II
description:
**Company Description**  

At Xplor, we help businesses thrive by making life simple for daily activities with a recurring nature. We do that by offering smart software, payments, and commerce\-enabling solutions across five “everyday life” verticals: Education, Health and Fitness, Boutique Wellness, Field Services and Personal Services.


You’ll join Xplor Field Services — the team that builds innovative and intuitive solutions for businesses like lawn care, cleaning, snow removal, and more. We help owners streamline scheduling, dispatching, and billing, and with powerful automation, they save time, grow profits, and deliver a smoother experience to their customers.


Our core values \- Make Life Simple, Build for People, Move with Purpose, and Create Lasting Communities are key to who we are and what guides us from how we hire to how we recognize our team members.

 **Job Description**  

Job Description


You’ll join Xplor Field Services and our Global Technology team — You’ll help us enhance our industry\-leading platform used by our customer base to run their businesses. Some of the other responsibilities you’ll have:

* Design, develop, and test software applications using .NET Framework, .NET Core, C\# and Microsoft.
* Work to extend, troubleshoot and optimize existing framework for stability, scalability and improved member experience.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues in existing software applications.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies, and apply that knowledge to improve our software development processes and tools.

* Strong understanding of SQL server and the ability to write stored procedures.
* Strong understanding of software design patterns and principles.
* Strong experience in building Rest/JSON based Web Services in .NET.
* Experience with version control systems such as Git.

  

**Additional Information**  

.**More about us**


We are the first global platform combining SaaS with embedded payments and tools to help businesses grow and succeed. We offer software solutions in fast\-growing “everyday life” verticals: Education, Fitness \& Wellbeing, Field Services and Personal Services – and a global, cloud\-based payment processing platform. title: Custom Software Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high\-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
  

**Must have skills :** AWS Networking  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Custom Software Engineer, a typical day involves creating tailored software solutions by designing, coding, and improving various components within systems or applications. The role requires working with modern development frameworks and following agile methodologies to ensure the delivery of scalable and efficient software that meets unique business requirements. Collaboration with different teams and continuous refinement of software elements are integral parts of the daily workflow, fostering innovation and responsiveness to evolving project needs.  

We are looking for a Senior Network \& Kubernetes Migration Specialist (6–9 years experience) to lead and execute large\-scale AWS network and container platform migration initiatives. This role requires deep expertise in AWS networking, enterprise hybrid connectivity, and strong hands\-on experience with Amazon EKS from both infrastructure and application perspectives.  

  

1\. AWS Network Architecture \& Migration  

* Lead end\-to\-end migration of on\-premises and hybrid network environments to AWS.
* Design complex AWS networking architectures including multi\-account VPC strategy, subnet segmentation, routing, NAT, IGW, and load balancing.
* Architect and implement AWS Transit Gateway (hub\-and\-spoke, inter\-region, multi\-account connectivity).
* Design hybrid connectivity using AWS Direct Connect, Site\-to\-Site VPN, and BGP routing.
* Perform network segmentation aligned with zero\-trust principles.
* Lead migration risk assessment, rollback planning, and phased cutover strategies.
* Optimize network cost, latency, and high availability post migration.

  

2\. Security \& Governance  

* Define and enforce enterprise\-grade security policies using Security Groups, NACLs, AWS Network Firewall, and third\-party firewalls.
* Implement inspection VPC and centralized egress architectures.
* Collaborate with security teams on compliance and regulatory requirements.
* Implement guardrails using SCPs and IAM boundaries.

  

3\. Amazon EKS – Infrastructure Perspective  

* Design and operate production\-grade Amazon EKS clusters.
* Architect multi\-cluster and multi\-environment EKS strategies.
* Design cluster networking (CNI, IP management, pod density planning).
* Optimize VPC CNI, prefix delegation, and subnet sizing.
* Implement cluster autoscaling using Karpenter and Cluster Autoscaler.
* Manage node lifecycle, taints/tolerations, and capacity planning.
* Implement IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts).
* Upgrade and patch Kubernetes clusters with minimal downtime.

  

4\. Amazon EKS – Application Perspective  

* Support application teams in migrating workloads to Kubernetes.
* Design ingress strategies (ALB / NGINX Ingress).
* Optimize application networking (Services, Network Policies, DNS).
* Troubleshoot pod\-to\-pod and cross\-cluster communication issues.
* Implement scalability and resilience patterns (HPA, PDB, readiness/liveness probes).

  

5\. Platform Engineering \& Automation  

* Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform (modular approach).
* Implement GitOps workflows using Argo CD.
* Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
* Define policy\-as\-code using Kyverno.
* Develop automation scripts using Python or Go.

  

Required Skills \& Qualifications  

* 6–9 years of experience in AWS infrastructure, networking, and cloud\-migrations.
* Strong expertise in AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and VPN.
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking concepts (BGP, routing, firewalls, segmentation).
* Strong production experience with Amazon EKS (cluster design, scaling, networking optimization).
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes networking internals.
* Strong Terraform expertise (module design, remote state management).
* Experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Scripting experience with Python or Go.
* Strong troubleshooting and stakeholder communication skills.

  

15 years full time education

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**


AtkinsRéalis is one of the world's leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We are proud to say it is thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise, and knowledge. We offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world. Our teams are proud to deliver on some of the most prestigious projects across the world. It's thanks to our talented people and their diverse thinking, expertise and knowledge. Join us and you'll be part of our genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone is supported to make the most of their talents and expertise.


The Lead Software Engineer is responsible for contributing to the design, development, deployment, and operation of secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions.


The role provides technical leadership within an assigned product area or project, contributes to architectural and design decisions, and ensures that solutions comply with organizational engineering, quality, security, and operational standards.


The role is expected to lead complex projects, coordinate technical delivery across participating teams, mentor software engineers, and act as a key technical contact for project stakeholders.

**Your role**

* Lead the technical delivery of complex projects.
* Contribute to technical planning, estimation, scheduling, dependency identification, and delivery tracking.
* Break technical solutions into implementable work packages and engineering tasks.
* Allocate or delegate technical activities within the team when appropriate.
* Monitor technical progress against agreed project objectives, quality expectations, milestones, and timelines.

description:

--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

Role summary


The Staff Software Engineer (IC4\) on HR Service Delivery designs, builds, ships, and operates capabilities whose core behavior is model\-driven rather than explicitly authored: agentic and conversational experiences that interpret an employee's, manager's, or HR agent's intent, reason over employee profile, case, catalog, policy, and knowledge context, invoke tools, and act on the user's behalf across the employee lifecycle.


This is not a machine learning or AI research role; the engineer does not train foundation models. It is also distinct from traditional full\-stack engineering, where systems follow deterministic logic rather than selecting execution paths at runtime. Two consequences shape the work. First, the most important logic often lives in natural language: instructions, prompts, tool descriptions, guardrails, escalation rules, all of which must be engineered, versioned, and reviewed with the same discipline as code. Second, because behavior is probabilistic, correctness is established by measuring behavior at scale rather than by asserting fixed outputs, making automated evaluation a first\-class engineering activity rather than a quality\-assurance afterthought.


HR sharpens both points along two independent axes.

**Accuracy.** An agent answering on payroll, benefits, leave, or a lifecycle event touches statutory entitlement, jurisdiction\-specific policy, and an employee's pay. A confidently wrong output is not a bad answer; it is a missed enrollment window or an incorrect leave balance acted on in good faith.

**Audience.** HR data is among the most sensitive on the platform, and correctness of content is not sufficient. An answer grounded in a record or knowledge article the requestor is not entitled to read is a data exposure even when every fact in it is true, and manager\-scope and employee\-scope views of the same question have different correct answers. Access boundaries have to be enforced in the retrieval and tool layer rather than requested of the model.


At IC4 the engineer owns AI design decisions across the domain, not within a single feature, and owns the correctness of what ships whether a person or an agent produced it.


What you do Build AI\-native capability across the employee lifecycle


Design and ship features built around agentic behavior — intent interpretation, multi\-step reasoning, tool invocation, and action on the user's behalf — together with the data models, integrations, and channels that make them usable in production. In HRSD this spans guided service selection and intake, natural\-language case creation and enrichment, conversational case status and in\-flight change, tiered resolution of payroll and benefits inquiries, case triage, routing, and deflection, eligibility and entitlement inquiry, and agent\-driven execution of onboarding, transfer, and offboarding lifecycle events.


Design AI\-driven autonomous workflows


Decompose HR processes into the steps and decision points an agent can execute: determining where autonomy is appropriate, where a checkpoint with a person is required, and how exceptions, retries, and hand\-back are handled. Anything that changes pay, employment status, or a restricted record, and anything touching employee relations or investigation, needs a human decision point by construction. The design must make that distinction structural rather than advisory.


Author and maintain agentic instructions as engineering artifacts


Write, structure, and version the system instructions, role definitions, tool descriptions, guardrails, and escalation paths that govern agent behavior in the domain, under code review, source control, and regression coverage. Own the shared instruction and tool\-description surface that adjacent teams build against. Because HRSD ships as product, customers configure, extend, and override that surface on their own instances: treat it as public API, with upgrade\-safe extension points and versioning discipline to match.


Build automated evaluation and test non\-deterministic behavior


Design and operate the evaluation that makes change safe: golden datasets, multi\-turn conversation suites, model\-as\-judge scoring calibrated to human review, CI gates, and drift detection, plus adversarial, jailbreak, grounding, and tool\-selection testing. Extend that coverage to the HR\-specific failure classes — access\-boundary violations in retrieval and citation, PII leakage across scopes, and jurisdictional and policy\-variant correctness — and keep evaluation meaningful across customer configurations rather than against a single reference dataset. Own the resolution, containment, and quality metrics the domain is measured on, including whether they are instrumented correctly in the first place.


Design conversational experiences across channels


Build experiences that hold context across turns, hand off cleanly between automated and live HR agents, and behave consistently across employee\-facing portals, chat shells, workplace messaging clients, agent workspace, and voice — accounting for what voice imposes: latency budgets, barge\-in, speech recognition error on names and plan terminology, disambiguation, and explicit confirmation before consequential actions.


Specify precisely and direct AI coding agents


Convert requirements into testable specifications with explicit scope, constraints, non\-goals, and acceptance criteria; decompose work into agent\-sized tasks; supervise several workstreams in parallel; and review agent output for correctness, spec adherence, security, and maintainability. You own the result regardless of what produced it.


Own quality, safety, and reliability in production


Monitor conversation quality, containment, hallucination rate, tool\-selection error, and unsafe or unauthorized action. Defend against prompt injection and data leakage across integration surfaces, including the paths where user\-supplied content — case notes, inbound email, attachments, authored knowledge — enters agent context. Maintain reasoning\-trace observability and model rollback mechanisms, and feed production failures back into specifications and evaluation sets. Because HR conversation content is itself restricted, design that observability to be diagnosable without exposing what was said. Lead root\-cause analysis when agentic behavior deviates from intent, and hold the line between a genuine model failure and a platform or configuration failure presenting as one.


Ground it in solid full\-stack delivery


Build the application, APIs, data models, and integrations around these capabilities: front\-end experiences for employees, managers, and HR agents, server\-side logic, and the connections to HCM, payroll, benefits, identity, knowledge, and the adjacent service domains HR cases cross into — with the CI/CD, observability, and upgrade\-safe extensibility expected of production software.


Collaborate across product, design, and engineering


Partner with product managers, designers, conversation designers, HR domain and compliance partners, and engineers to define success criteria and communicate capability and risk clearly. Mentor IC1 to IC3 engineers, and raise the team's practices around instruction authoring, evaluation, and accountable agent use.
